releases.notes:
# WorldEventCoords Exploit!
This module did not work as expected before. 

**Instead of providing you the position of the event as the packet suggests, it actually gives you a position that is in the direction of that world event.**

When you receive a world event now, the module will tell you to move in a certain direction and wait for more events. You must ensure you get far away from your original position so you can actually get an accurate triangulation. 

- For the triangulation to work you must recieve bare minimum 2 events within the Triangulation window that you set. 
- You must shift the bearing degrees by at least 1 degree by moving in the suggested direction before you receive the last of the events. The distance that you have to move for a triangulation is dependant on the distance of the targeted event.
- After the window has elapsed all the events will be computed, or when you deactivate the module. This is when you recieve your triangulation result.

# NoModDetection update!
Instead of filtering Translation keys accross the whole client we now just filter translation keys that may be contained in SignUpdatePackets. The servers that detect translation keys from mods use sign update packets to detect if you have mods. 
Thank you to **gorynych** from our [Discord server](https://www.breakblocks.com/discord) for suggesting to only send the server the fallbacks instead of rendering it in the client.
 **This resolves all crashes that NoModDetection had that were from modifying translation keys!**

- All settings have been removed as they are not needed now. 
- By default the module now filters every translation key the game has from mods and also the vanilla ones too.

# CubePrimer update!
- Moved all the functionality of the Cube Automation module into Cube Primer. There is no longer a need for the "Cube Automation" module so I deleted it.
- Made entity scanning more reliable for TNT and Ignition Aura.
- Included a tick delay option for the Cube Dumper.
- Improved Cube Dumper logic.
- Seperated tick delays for TNT and Ignition aura.
- Do things on Meteor's "Packet.Send" event instead of the interact entity event. This allows more flexibility in the module.
- Added a missing warning for not having TNT to TNT aura.
- Ensured that errors for TNT and Ignition aura can only happen once per tick at most.
- Ensured that only either TNT aura OR Ignition aura can do things per tick to reduce potential packet spam. 
- Included options "Disable Near Farm", "Safe Distance From Farm", "Farm Coordinate" settings. These will prevent the TNT and Ignition Aura from doing things near the coordinate that you set. This helps to prevent accidents! Thank you to **2xc3** for the suggestion.

# Random code stuff! 
- Merged [pull request 313](https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/pull/313) by [JAXPLE](https://github.com/JAXPLE) which fixes a null crash with NoModDetection.
- Make "ColorModes" private and using their own enum in AirStrikePlus, Boom+, Nbtditor, and AutoTexts.
___

releases.notes:
# New Stuff! 

## CubeAutomation module added
Automatically do things with Sulfur Cubes! This Module is intended to be paired with CubePrimer to maximize it's efficiency.
Features:
**Cube Hotbar Dumper:** When you use a Sulfur Cube Bucket or regular Bucket, automatically select the next Sulfur Cube Bucket for placing.
**TNT Insertion Aura:** Automatically insert TNT into empty Cubes within range.
**Ignition Aura:** Automatically ignite TNT Sulfur Cubes within range.

**Use this module in combination with CubePrimer to make alot of invincible cubes fast.**

## LodestoneCoords module added
This new module decodes the stored coords in a Lodestone Compass, giving you the location of that Lodestone. 
Thank you to [Dylanvip2024](https://github.com/Dylanvip2024) for writing this for us! https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/310

## WorldEventCoords module added
This module displays the BlockPos of different global world events that occur.
Supported events are:
- ENDER_DRAGON_DIES
- END_PORTAL_OPENED
- WITHER_SPAWNS
- unknown global events

## New HUD Element "Censor" 
Added the a new HUD element called "Censor" that is simply a rectangle with customizable size, color, and position. You can also put some text into it.
This may be useful for hiding something if you are streaming or recording or making a screenshot of something sensitive.

Thank you to [its2xc3](https://github.com/its2xc3) for making this for us in this pull request: https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/pull/311
**That pull request also added a new section for Trouser to the list of hud elements.**

# Updates! 

## AutoLavaCaster
- Added "Fill Missing Blocks" which ensure the blocks for increasing the height of the lavacast are all placed before continuing.
- Fixed the hundreds of "Static member 'pwn.noobs.trouserstreak.modules.AutoMountain.*' accessed via instance reference".
- Simplified all the silly boolean evaluations everywhere.
## AutoWither
- Added a "Delay" setting to allow for ticks between block placements. Default is no delay.
## CubePrimer
- Do not do the stuff if the world or player are null.
- Do not do stuff if you have insert block selected and you are not having one of those blocks in your hotbar. 
## Lava Aura
- Improved entity scanning performance. Maybe resolves this issue: https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/309
- Cleaned up code a little bit.

___
**Customer Support: https://www.breakblocks.com/discord**

**Sub to our [Youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@mountainsoflavainc.6913) for lots of block breaking!**

Check out the [Trouser-Streak releases page](https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/releases) if you missed any recent updates to catch up on new features.

releases.notes:
# New Module!
## UUIDBan module!
This new module uses funny Operator level commands to ban a player.

First, the target player gets kicked.
Then after a delay an entity is created using /summon with their UUID. **This prevents the targeted player from joining back until that entity is killed by /kill.**

**If you hide that entity in unloaded chunks it may never be killed making the ban permanent.**

You can choose a target player by either right clicking on them, or by typing in their name. There is also an option to execute commands for all players simultaneously.
Commands are executed by either pressing the attackKey, or on a tick delay if that is disabled.

**This module was originally created and provided to me by KI10**, then I modified it heavily to fit my desires. Thank you to KI10 for the new ban method!

# A couple Modules almost entirely rewritten!
## RemoteEnderChest
Implemented a vastly improved rewrite by [JirkaMaster](https://github.com/JirkaMaster9) from their fork, heavily modified by etianl. Give many thanks to JirkaMaster for this!

This rewrite makes the stored Ender Chest GUI function and appear more normal. It also removes the janky re-routed controls that I had written in. 
**All normal controls and the Chat functions are now available when storing an Ender Chest GUI!!!**

I also removed the reliance on detecting the english "ender" in the ender chest GUI to detect if we had opened an ender chest GUI for linking. Instead it will use the block under your crosshair when you interact with the ender chest to detect if you are opening an ender chest GUI. **This allows the module to work even when the GUI is translated**

**Opening your inventory, exiting the Ender Chest GUI by not pressing the hotkey, or transitioning between worlds will close the GUI and break your link with the Ender Chest!!!**

**Interacting with certain things like Crafting Tables, Anvils, Furnaces, Storage Blocks, and many other blocks will also break the link with the error: "Ender chest handler invalid".**

## SuperInstaMine
Pretty much entirely rewrote the module using much more efficient/optimized code. Functionality remains largely the same though! It may have even been improved..
- Everything now runs on send packet instead of the StartBreakingBlockEvent which is more reliable.
- I may have fixed some bugs too but I didn't keep close track of them because of the sheer volume of code that was changed.

# Bug Fixes/Code Changes! 
## NewerNewChunks and BaseFinder
Reverted a change to chunk loading from packet. 

**This should fix the error about accessing things from outside the main render thread when using this module with the Sodium mod.** Resolves this issue: https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/243

## AimBot
- Added "Only if holding Item/s." setting which only runs the aimbot if you have a selected item in your Main Hand. Suggested by someone in our [Discord server](https://www.breakblocks.com/discord)!
- Added missing null guard for player and world.

## ArmorStandImages
- **Added "Place Mode" option which allows you to choose to spawn the armor stands via spawn egg, or command.** Suggested in this issue: https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/238
- Made default "Place Mode" spawn egg because that only needs Creative mode not Operator status.
- Moved the warning about needing operator status to when you press the "Place Keybind" instead of when you activate the module. 
- Removed isChunkLoaded requirement from checking player permission level.

## AttributeSwap
- Added "Auto Lunge Swap" setting. This setting automatically swaps to a Spear with the Lunge enchantment when you press the attack key allowing you to lunge very rapidly. **This may allow fast movement on servers that restrict it!**
- Made "Shield Breaker No Swap" true by default.
- Do not trigger swap back delay if there is no swap, due to the "Shield Breaker No Swap" option.

**Updated to Minecraft 1.21.10!**

## InfiniteTools Module Added!
Thank you to therandomdude for suggesting this here! https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/134
At the moment a block breaks this module will swap the tool you are using for a junk copy of that tool.
**This lets you use your good efficiency tools while burning the durability of other junk tools!!!**

- Stone is recommended for junk tools.
- Supports Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, and Swords. (and probably more if I write it in)
- *Some tool combinations do not work well for this module*

Demonstration video showing the durability usages:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d6RUr8oKkOs
[![Watch on YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/d6RUr8oKkOs/0.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d6RUr8oKkOs)
**Sub to our Youtube channel for lots of block breaking!**

## Other Things
- support dropped for some minecraft versions (if enough people bug me about a single version I may make an exception)
- Merged PR (https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/pull/138) from https://github.com/Puyodead1 adding starscript support to BetterAutoSign
- Added a feature to NewerNewChunks which plays a configurable alarm sound when you are encountering new chunks. As requested here: https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/137
- Moved a couple things in the InstaMineNuker class which may or may not prevent crashes referenced in this issue https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/issues/141
- Deleted a couple unused imports from ForceOPSign
- Added all the new copper blocks and shelves that are not natural to the BaseFinder module to help with base detection. (in 1.21.10)
- Also updated the blocklist for the BlockListMineCommand module which generates a mineflayer command that you can use to mine un-natural blocks around you.  (in 1.21.10)

This new module takes your elytra off every 15 ticks for two ticks then re-equips it to prevent the elytra from taking damage. The timings can be adjusted as needed.

This module was requested here:

## WaypointCoordExploit Module Added!

This new module abuses the new waypoint system that shows the direction to other players that are online on a server in Minecraft version 1.21.6 to show the coordinates of other players.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e2365a7-2775-4119-b948-9f7684de412f)
**There is now a new hud element called "Waypoint Triangulations" for displaying the coordinates so you can avoid chat spam about them.**

- The locations that are displayed will also come with the name of the player who was detected.
- For the module to work correctly you should walk perpendicular to the waypoint a little bit to triangulate it's location.
- You must walk slowly for the module to calculate correctly. 
- If you have high ping that can also affect the accuracy of calculations.
- Once in a while the waypoint packets are no longer sent by the server for a player, in that case you or the player may have to logout then back in for the packets to resume being sent. The packets may also resume being sent if the target player/s start moving.
- The waypoint packets containing the data used for triangulation are only sent when the waypoint is small, which means it only works when you are far away from the other players.

*If you like Trouser Streak give it a star on github!*

## Updated to Minecraft 1.21.5!

- Merged Pull Request https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/pull/109 from [zxcv05](https://github.com/zxcv05) which helped with the 1.21.5 update. Thanks!
- Changed code slightly in many classes to make them more cross-compatible between 1.21.5 and older versions. This should not affect functionality it just makes it easier for my coding
## Also made a backport to Minecraft 1.21.1!
**1.21.3 support will be dropped starting the next Trouser release**
##
## CollectibleESP Module Added!
This new module highlights maps and different items in item frames, as well as banners.
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c90db3eb-7a4a-49fd-81c4-8a8f01d338e2)
This module was merged from this Pull Request https://github.com/etianl/Trouser-Streak/pull/108 made by [xqyet](https://github.com/xqyet) then heavily modified by etianl

Thank you to https://github.com/xqyet for providing this code for us to play with!

## Organized Modules!
Separated modules into three categories. 
The new categories are "TrouserStreak", "TrouserHunting", "TrouserOP/Creative"
- **TrouserStreak** is the main category and will contain modules usable in survival mode and other misc stuff.
- **TrouserHunting** will contain modules which are designed for hunting down different things in the game. 
- **TrouserOP/Creative** will contain modules usable only by operators and/or players in creative mode.
 
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a0ed1e9c-2425-4d59-9943-d0b778857574)

## Did some other things too!
- Fixed ForceOPSigns not working with 1.21.4 clients
- Fixed Items not appearing clientside after they are created with ForceOPSign, ForceOPBook and NbtEditor.

-This also includes automated server version detection to ensure signs get formatted with the correct NBT data. If the version is null then the manual settings will be used

**New Discord Server for Updates and Friends:** https://discord.gg/Az3G3p4ZCj

***ForceOPSign Module Added!***

Demonstration video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YICXSxkvBfQ

More details and a standalone version of the mod is here:
https://github.com/etianl/ForceOPSign

*Notes:*
- Added the ForceOPSign module which allows you to make signs in Creative mode that are pre-loaded with operator level commands. 
To use the ForceOPSign module, configure the options to make it execute the commands you want (default is /op yourname) then give the sign to an operator who is also in creative mode and have them place then right click on the sign.
The signs that ForceOPSign creates appear to be blank when placed, so the person may not know there is anything wrong with them.

Thank you to [Rob](https://www.youtube.com/@sheepymcgoat) for figuring out to use \n (newline) characters to make the sign blank and for figuring out the exploit is permission level based.

- The commands that are executed by the ForceOPSign do not always appear in server chat response of operator commands. The operator will have no idea they just made you an operator when that command executes from the sign.
- There is an option to use the last three lines on the sign for a set of commands to auto grief a server. (These use /execute commands which only work in Minecraft 1.13 or higher)
- There is also an option to have the sign run a command to disable a server and have it crash over and over again. 

**OPERATORS CLICKING SIGNS CAN ONLY EXECUTE THE /OP COMMAND ON MINECRAFT VERSIONS GREATER THAN v1.12.2 and only if the server is PAPER (or other modded versions)**
(Paper versions grant atleast command permission level 3 on signs. Thats why we can Force OP on all Paper versions including the most recent.)

**IN VANILLA SERVERS AND PAPER VERSIONS LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO v1.12.2 THEN ANYONE CAN ONLY EXECUTE PERMISSION LEVEL 2 COMMANDS WHEN CLICKING SIGNS**
This is still really good and fun. You can run permission level two commands.
**Any Player** can click these signs after the OP places and it **executes** the commands. (Operators could have fun trolling their players with this!)
This includes /fill commands and even /setblock which could allow you to insert a malicious command block into the server in a spot that the admin does not know about.
Gamerule commands are also permission level 2 meaning that you could get an admin to change any gamerule you want without them knowing, just use "/gamerule sendCommandFeedback false" as a command before the rest.

I also made a build of Meteor Client for 1.20.4 from the latest source available for that Minecraft version. This is required for Trouser-Streak for 1.20.4!
https://github.com/etianl/meteor-client-1.20.4/releases/tag/0.5.6

**OTHER UPDATES**
- Added a Render Distance option to **Hole/Tunnel/StairsESP** which removes the rendered boxes that are outside of the render distance that you define. This fixes the lag due to the boxes staying loaded forever
- Added a Command Delay option to the **AutoCommand** module. This adds a delay between listed commands. 
- Removed the FULL AUTO option from **AutoCommand** and replaced it with an option called "Loop Commands" which decides whether or not to loop the defined commands.
- Fixed BoatKill not killing things for some reason.
- Updated the **.world command** to show your permission level for commands.
